title: Canonical exact-derived affine algebra counit is invertible
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be an affine morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $g:(X,\mathcal O_X)\to(Y,f_*\mathcal O_X)$ be its direct-image-algebra morphism [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category]. Assume the derived categories of module sheaves [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] over both ringed spaces exist. Let $P:\operatorname{Mod}(f_*\mathcal O_X)\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ be additive and preserve finite limits and finite colimits, with an adjunction $a:P\dashv g_*$ to module direct image [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. Let $b:D(P)\dashv Rg_*$ be the canonical derived adjunction induced by $a$, using termwise exact $P$ and the K-injective right-derived functor [lem-sc-derived-adjunction-from-underived]. For every $K\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ whose cohomology sheaves are quasi-coherent in all integer degrees [def-pc-derived-category], the counit $b_K:D(P)(Rg_*K)\to K$ is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Choose a K-injective complex I and an isomorphism K to Q(I), using the ringed-space K-injective resolutions. Transport quasi-coherence of cohomology across the homology functor and its Q comparison.

In every integer degree apply lem-sc-affine-algebra-kinjective-counit-homology-factorization. Its comparison factors the homology of the termwise counit as the exact P homology comparison, P of the algebra-linear pushforward comparison, and the ordinary module counit. Install the right-adjoint instance supplied by a. The canonical ordinary counit is invertible on H^n(I) by new-affine-algebra-module-counit-iso; transport to a with leftAdjointUniq_hom_app_counit. Every factor is invertible. Thus the termwise counit is a quasi-isomorphism.

The homotopy counit on the quotient of I is the quotient of the termwise counit, hence Qh sends it to an isomorphism. Apply derivedε_fac_app to the canonical derived adjunction. The right-derived unit at I is invertible because I is K-injective, and the exact P comparison is invertible. Cancellation in this equation proves that the canonical derived counit at Qh(I) is invertible.

Compose K to Q(I) with the inverse of quotientCompQhIso. Naturality of the canonical derived counit along this isomorphism transports invertibility to K. This preserves both derived-category universes and uses no derived unit or unit homology factorization.

theorem affine_algebra_exact_derived_counit_isIso
    {X Y : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)))]
    (P : SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    [P.Additive] [Limits.PreservesFiniteLimits P] [Limits.PreservesFiniteColimits P]
    (a : P ⊣ RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f))
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hK : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X K) :
    IsIso ((a.mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction).counit.app K)
